name: Honda Manufacturing of Indiana (HMIN) - Greensburg IN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Waze records a distinct 'Truck entrance' at 2755 N Michigan Ave separate from the visitor 'Main entrance'. Entire campus is fenced and set ~400m back from public roads with a single managed industrial access corridor. truckGate=true is high confidence; the specific gate structure could not be directly imaged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Not directly visible in available satellite crops and Street View pano coverage stops at the employee lot. A 24/7 auto assembly plant of this scale (Civic + CR-V, 250k vehicles/yr) effectively always has a staffed guarded truck gate; classified true on facility-class basis, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has the main dark-roofed assembly building, a large adjacent bright-roofed building (likely logistics/welding), support buildings (water treatment, paint ancillary), and a separate vehicle test track oval - true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts docks line the north faces of both main buildings; finished-vehicle outbound staging and rail loadout are on the south/southeast - physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of trailers parked in organized rows across multiple large drop lots north and east of the buildings, plus covered trailer stalls - well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur with a line of rail cars runs into the property along the southeast side of the assembly building (visible in z18 crop).
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~70 is an estimate aggregated across the long dock lines on the north faces of both main buildings; flagged approximate.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~380 trailers counted across the captured drop lots and dock lines; approximate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box covers the full fenced property including the vehicle test track; ~1480 acres is derived from the box and is a rough figure.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal access corridors and ample paved apron width provide room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery; flagged uncertain.
